tools.description: Archive one of the caller's flyers (issue #51: archive hides from new selections)
tools.sql: UPDATE flyers SET archived_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id AND archived_at IS NULL

tools.name: unarchive_flyer
tools.description: Unarchive one of the caller's flyers
tools.sql: UPDATE flyers SET archived_at = NULL WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_campaigns_using_flyer
tools.description: Campaigns that have a printout referencing this flyer (issue #51: dependency check)
tools.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name, c.status FROM campaigns c JOIN printouts p ON p.campaign_id = c.id WHERE p.flyer_id = :flyer_id AND c.id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE aj.value = :__user_id) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

tools.name: delete_flyer
tools.description: Delete one of the caller's flyers (issue #51: blocked if any campaign references it)
tools.sql: DELETE FROM flyers WHERE id = :id AND owner_id = :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM printouts WHERE flyer_id = :id)

tools.name: list_my_properties
tools.description: Properties the caller has access to, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM properties p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(p.access_user_ids) j WHERE j.value = :__user_id) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 500

tools.name: upsert_property
tools.description: Create a property, or add the caller to an existing one (by its address-derived id)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO properties (id, address, street_name, house_number, suburb, postcode, state, lat, lng, commercial, access_user_ids, created_at) VALUES (:id, :address, :street_name, :house_number, :suburb, :postcode, :state, :lat, :lng, :commercial, json_array(:__user_id), :__now) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET access_user_ids = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(properties.access_user_ids) j WHERE j.value = :__user_id) THEN properties.access_user_ids ELSE json_insert(properties.access_user_ids, '$[#]', :__user_id) END

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: A property the caller has access to
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM properties p WHERE p.id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties pa, json_each(pa.access_user_ids) pj WHERE pa.id = p.id AND pj.value = :__user_id)

tools.name: property_access
tools.description: Whether the caller has access to a property (no row: it does not exist)
tools.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties pa, json_each(pa.access_user_ids) pj WHERE pa.id = p.id AND pj.value = :__user_id) AS has_access FROM properties p WHERE p.id = :id

tools.name: update_property
tools.description: Update a property the caller has access to; access_user_ids can grow, never shrink
tools.sql: UPDATE properties SET address = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.address') IS NULL THEN address ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.address') END, street_name = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.street_name') IS NULL THEN street_name ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.street_name') END, house_number = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.house_number') IS NULL THEN house_number ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.house_number') END, suburb = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.suburb') IS NULL THEN suburb ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.suburb') END, postcode = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.postcode') IS NULL THEN postcode ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.postcode') END, state = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.state') IS NULL THEN state ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.state') END, lat = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.lat') IS NULL THEN lat ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.lat') END, lng = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.lng') IS NULL THEN lng ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.lng') END, commercial = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.commercial') IS NULL THEN commercial ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.commercial') END, access_user_ids = CASE WHEN json_type(:patch, '$.access_user_ids') IS NULL THEN access_user_ids ELSE json_extract(:patch, '$.access_user_ids') END WHERE id = :id AND (json_type(:patch, '$.access_user_ids') IS NULL OR (json_type(:patch, '$.access_user_ids') = 'array' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(properties.access_user_ids) o WHERE o.value NOT IN (SELECT n.value FROM json_each(:patch, '$.access_user_ids') n)))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties pa, json_each(pa.access_user_ids) pj WHERE pa.id = :id AND pj.value = :__user_id)

patch.description: JSON object of the columns to change

tools.name: create_property_report
tools.description: Report a problem with a property the caller has access to
tools.sql: INSERT INTO property_reports (id, property_id, reason, photo_url, notes, reported_at, reported_by, campaign_id) SELECT :id, :property_id, :reason, :photo_url, :notes, :__now, :__user_id, :campaign_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties pa, json_each(pa.access_user_ids) pj WHERE pa.id = :property_id AND pj.value = :__user_id)

tools.name: list_property_reports
tools.description: Reports on a property the caller has access to, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM property_reports WHERE property_id = :property_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties pa, json_each(pa.access_user_ids) pj WHERE pa.id = :property_id AND pj.value = :__user_id) ORDER BY reported_at DESC

tools.name: list_interests
tools.description: Walker interests (filtered by campaign: campaign-admin only; by walker: self or admin)
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM walker_interests WHERE (:walker_id IS NULL OR walker_id = :walker_id OR :walker_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')) AND (:campaign_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_interest
tools.description: Register the caller's (walker-only) interest in a campaign and notify its admins
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO walker_interests (id, walker_id, campaign_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, c.id, :__now, :__now FROM campaigns c, users u WHERE c.id = :campaign_id AND u.id = :__user_id AND u.role = 'walker'

INSERT INTO notifications (id, user_id, type, title, body, campaign_id, read, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), j.value, 'walker_interested', 'New walker interested', COALESCE((SELECT u.name FROM users u WHERE u.id = :__user_id), :__user_id) || ' wants to deliver for ' || c.name, c.id, 0, :__now FROM campaigns c, json_each(c.admin_ids) j WHERE c.id = :campaign_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM walker_interests i WHERE i.id = :id AND i.walker_id = :__user_id AND i.created_at = :__now)

tools.name: interest_owner
tools.description: Whether the caller owns a walker interest (no row: it does not exist)
tools.sql: SELECT walker_id = :__user_id AS mine FROM walker_interests WHERE id = :id

tools.name: delete_my_interest
tools.description: Withdraw one of the caller's walker interests
tools.sql: DELETE FROM walker_interests WHERE id = :id AND walker_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_walker_reviews
tools.description: A walker's reviews, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM walker_reviews WHERE walker_id = :walker_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

caller_unscoped.reason: Faithful port of the pre-port worker, where any signed-in user could read these rows (platform#264); tightening is tracked separately.

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Review a walker as the caller
tools.sql: INSERT INTO walker_reviews (id, walker_id, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, campaign_id, schedule_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :walker_id, :__user_id, :reviewer_name, :campaign_id, :schedule_id, :rating, :comment, :__now, :__now WHERE :rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND (:comment IS NULL OR length(:comment) <= 2000)

tools.name: review_owner
tools.description: Whether the caller wrote a review (no row: it does not exist)
tools.sql: SELECT reviewer_id = :__user_id AS mine FROM walker_reviews WHERE id = :id

tools.name: update_my_review
tools.description: Change the rating or comment of one of the caller's reviews
tools.sql: UPDATE walker_reviews SET rating = COALESCE(:rating, rating), comment = COALESCE(:comment, comment), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND reviewer_id = :__user_id AND (:rating IS NULL OR :rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND (:comment IS NULL OR length(:comment) <= 2000)

tools.name: delete_my_review
tools.description: Delete one of the caller's reviews
tools.sql: DELETE FROM walker_reviews WHERE id = :id AND reviewer_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_history
tools.description: Delivery history records (self or admin only), optionally for one walker, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM history_records WHERE (:walker_id IS NULL OR :walker_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')) AND (:walker_id IS NULL OR walker_id = :walker_id) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_history
tools.description: Record a delivery history entry for the caller
tools.sql: INSERT INTO history_records (id, walker_id, date, street_name, income, door_count, duration_min) VALUES (:id, :__user_id, :date, :street_name, :income, :door_count, :duration_min)

tools.name: admin_delete_history
tools.description: Admin: delete a history record
tools.sql: DELETE FROM history_records WHERE id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')

tools.name: list_my_notifications
tools.description: The caller's notifications (optionally unread only), newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND (:unread = 0 OR read = 0) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: notification_owner
tools.description: Whether a notification is the caller's (no row: it does not exist)
tools.sql: SELECT user_id = :__user_id AS mine FROM notifications WHERE id = :id

tools.name: set_notification_read
tools.description: Mark one of the caller's notifications read or unread
tools.sql: UPDATE notifications SET read = :read WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: mark_all_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark all the caller's notifications read
tools.sql: UPDATE notifications SET read = 1 WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND read = 0

tools.name: list_campaign_notes
tools.description: A campaign's notes (campaign admin or assigned walker), oldest first, optionally after a time
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM campaign_notes WHERE campaign_id = :campaign_id AND (:since IS NULL OR created_at > :since) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns cw WHERE cw.id = :campaign_id AND cw.assigned_walker_id = :__user_id)) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_campaign_note
tools.description: Post a note on a campaign (campaign admin or assigned walker)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO campaign_notes (id, campaign_id, user_id, user_name, text, created_at) SELECT :id, :campaign_id, :__user_id, :user_name, :text, :created_at WHERE length(:text) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 AND length(:user_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns cw WHERE cw.id = :campaign_id AND cw.assigned_walker_id = :__user_id))

tools.name: set_chat_read_state
tools.description: Mark a campaign's chat read for the caller
tools.sql: INSERT INTO chat_read_state (user_id, campaign_id, last_read_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :campaign_id, :__now) ON CONFLICT(user_id, campaign_id) DO UPDATE SET last_read_at = excluded.last_read_at

tools.name: list_my_chat_read_state
tools.description: The caller's chat read state per campaign
tools.sql: SELECT campaign_id, last_read_at FROM chat_read_state WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: start_track_session
tools.description: Assigned walker: start a tracking session on the caller's campaign
tools.sql: INSERT INTO track_sessions (id, campaign_id, walker_id, started_at, ended_at) SELECT :id, :campaign_id, :__user_id, :__now, NULL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns cw WHERE cw.id = :campaign_id AND cw.assigned_walker_id = :__user_id AND cw.status IN ('ready','assigned'))

tools.name: list_track_sessions
tools.description: A campaign's tracking sessions (campaign admin, assigned walker or app admin), newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM track_sessions WHERE campaign_id = :campaign_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns cw WHERE cw.id = :campaign_id AND cw.assigned_walker_id = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200

tools.name: track_session_access
tools.description: The caller's standing on a tracking session (no row: it does not exist)
tools.sql: SELECT s.walker_id = :__user_id AS is_owner, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = s.campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) AS is_campaign_admin FROM track_sessions s WHERE s.id = :id

tools.name: append_track_point
tools.description: Append a GPS point to the caller's own tracking session
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO track_points (session_id, t, lat, lng, speed) SELECT :session_id, :t, :lat, :lng, :speed WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_sessions s, campaigns c WHERE s.id = :session_id AND s.walker_id = :__user_id AND c.id = s.campaign_id AND c.status IN ('ready','assigned'))

tools.name: append_track_stop
tools.description: Append a stop to the caller's own tracking session
tools.sql: INSERT INTO track_stops (id, session_id, lat, lng, start_time, end_time) SELECT :__uuid, :session_id, :lat, :lng, :start_time, :end_time WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_sessions s, campaigns c WHERE s.id = :session_id AND s.walker_id = :__user_id AND c.id = s.campaign_id AND c.status IN ('ready','assigned'))

tools.name: end_track_session
tools.description: End the caller's own tracking session
tools.sql: UPDATE track_sessions SET ended_at = :ended_at WHERE id = :id AND walker_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns c WHERE c.id = track_sessions.campaign_id AND c.status IN ('ready','assigned'))

tools.name: get_track_session
tools.description: A tracking session (its walker or a campaign admin)
tools.sql: SELECT s.* FROM track_sessions s WHERE s.id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_sessions sv WHERE sv.id = s.id AND (sv.walker_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = sv.campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id)))

tools.name: list_track_points
tools.description: A tracking session's GPS points (its walker or a campaign admin)
tools.sql: SELECT t, lat, lng, speed FROM track_points WHERE session_id = :session_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_sessions sv WHERE sv.id = :session_id AND (sv.walker_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = sv.campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id))) ORDER BY t

tools.name: list_track_stops
tools.description: A tracking session's stops (its walker or a campaign admin)
tools.sql: SELECT lat, lng, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime FROM track_stops WHERE session_id = :session_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_sessions sv WHERE sv.id = :session_id AND (sv.walker_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = sv.campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id))) ORDER BY start_time

tools.name: get_platform_config
tools.description: The app's payment-mode default
tools.sql: SELECT default_payment_mode FROM platform_config WHERE id = 'platform'

caller_unscoped.reason: App-wide setting every signed-in user reads; holds no user data.

tools.name: set_platform_config
tools.description: Admin: set the app's payment-mode default
tools.sql: INSERT INTO platform_config (id, default_payment_mode) SELECT 'platform', :default_payment_mode WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin') ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET default_payment_mode = excluded.default_payment_mode

tools.name: list_delivery_runs
tools.description: A campaign's delivery runs (campaign admin, assigned walker or app admin), soonest first
tools.sql: SELECT id, campaign_id, walker_id, status, date, created_at, updated_at FROM delivery_runs WHERE campaign_id = :campaign_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns cw WHERE cw.id = :campaign_id AND cw.assigned_walker_id = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 500

tools.name: get_delivery_run
tools.description: One delivery run (campaign admin, assigned walker or app admin)
tools.sql: SELECT id, campaign_id, walker_id, status, date, created_at, updated_at FROM delivery_runs WHERE id = :id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = delivery_runs.campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns cw WHERE cw.id = delivery_runs.campaign_id AND cw.assigned_walker_id = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: create_delivery_run
tools.description: Campaign admin: schedule a delivery run and touch the campaign
statements: INSERT INTO delivery_runs (id, campaign_id, walker_id, status, date, created_at) SELECT :id, :campaign_id, :walker_id, COALESCE(:status, 'scheduled'), :date, :__now WHERE COALESCE(:status, 'scheduled') IN ('scheduled','completed') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id)

UPDATE campaigns SET updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :campaign_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delivery_runs WHERE id = :id AND campaign_id = :campaign_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) aj WHERE aj.value = :__user_id)

tools.name: list_campaign_bookings
tools.description: A campaign's ShareHire bookings (campaign admin or the booked walker), newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM bookings WHERE campaign_id = :campaign_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id) OR walker_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book a walker for a campaign (campaign admin only); price is computed from the walker's rate
tools.sql: INSERT INTO bookings (id, campaign_id, walker_id, walker_name, client_id, date, door_count, rate_per_door, total_price, price_per_member, member_count, status, created_at) SELECT :id, :campaign_id, w.id, w.name, :__user_id, :date, :door_count, COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(w.walker_profile, '$.ratePerDoor') AS REAL), 0), :door_count * COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(w.walker_profile, '$.ratePerDoor') AS REAL), 0), CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT json_array_length(cm.member_ids) FROM campaigns cm WHERE cm.id = :campaign_id), 0) > 0 THEN :door_count * COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(w.walker_profile, '$.ratePerDoor') AS REAL), 0) / COALESCE((SELECT json_array_length(cm.member_ids) FROM campaigns cm WHERE cm.id = :campaign_id), 0) ELSE 0 END, COALESCE((SELECT json_array_length(cm.member_ids) FROM campaigns cm WHERE cm.id = :campaign_id), 0), 'pending', :created_at FROM users w WHERE w.id = :walker_id AND w.role = 'walker' AND :door_count BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaigns ca, json_each(ca.admin_ids) aj WHERE ca.id = :campaign_id AND aj.value = :__user_id)

tools.name: admin_stats
tools.description: Admin: platform-wide user, walker and campaign counts
tools.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'walker') AS walkers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaigns) AS campaigns WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')

tools.name: admin_list_doors
tools.description: Admin: every door across all campaigns with its campaign name and suburb, most recently visited first
tools.sql: SELECT d.id, d.campaign_id, d.address, d.street_name, d.house_number, d.status, d.delivered_at, d.delivery_count, d.history, c.name AS campaign_name, c.suburb AS suburb FROM doors d JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = d.campaign_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin') ORDER BY d.delivered_at DESC LIMIT 5000

tools.name: admin_set_campaign_status
tools.description: Admin: set a campaign's status and/or job status on any campaign
tools.sql: UPDATE campaigns SET status = COALESCE(:status, status), job_status = COALESCE(:job_status, job_status), completed_at = CASE WHEN :status = 'complete' THEN :__now ELSE completed_at END, archived_at = CASE WHEN :status = 'archive' THEN :__now ELSE archived_at END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND (:status IS NULL OR :status IN ('draft', 'ready', 'assigned', 'complete', 'review', 'payment', 'archive')) AND (:job_status IS NULL OR :job_status IN ('draft', 'posted', 'assigned', 'in_progress', 'completed')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users au WHERE au.id = :__user_id AND au.role = 'admin')
